judged_text: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController dereferences EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first without a nil check, so update crashes at host.host = ... and destroy crashes at nil.destroy on stale/missing records; likewise params[:embeddable_host][:host] raises when the param is missing/nil (and a nil host would crash the model's before_validation nil.sub!), producing 500 errors instead of 404/422 responses.
